periods.time: vol-15 ch-006, during the representative war

name.zh: 黑铁珠雫作为医疗支援抵达

periods.summary: A League emergency medical team reaches Vermillion, but its leader is Shizuku Kurogane rather than Kiriko Yakushi.
periods.cause: The representative war will inevitably produce casualties, and Vermillion lacks enough medical magic specialists; direct League combat intervention is limited by the five-on-five agreement, but indirect medical support is allowed.
periods.process: A League-marked emergency jet lands at Freyaveg. Royal guards and Daniel Dandallion meet the medical specialists and initially greet the young leader as the famous White-Robed Knight Kiriko Yakushi. Dandallion recognizes she is not Kiriko and asks where the doctor is. Shizuku explains that a Japanese prison-break incident has required World Clock and Raikiri to suppress it, so Kiriko must remain in Japan to support them. Shizuku, as Kiriko's direct disciple, persuaded the authorities to let her come instead.
periods.outcome: Shizuku joins the Vermillion-side support structure and is prepared to wait at the castle until Azure Gate access to Luxel is needed.
periods.aftermath: Her confidence implies badly injured representatives such as Yui may yet receive high-level medical aid despite the battlefield carnage.
periods.significance: Introduces the volume's late medical lifeline and connects the European war to simultaneous unrest in Japan.
